notes.title: Update on September 09, 2023.
notes.notes:
Now you can switch from Korean to English in both the lobby and in-game!

Currently, we only support English due to the rush in implementation, but we will gradually develop support for more languages in the future.

notes.title: The default language of the store page has been set to English
notes.notes:
Previously, through the Community Hub, we received feedback that for foreign users, it is difficult to read if the default store page is in Korean and that it would be better if the default store page was in English.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/2365300/discussions/0/3800527434453517929/

And this time, we have reflected this feedback by setting the store page and the default name of the game in English.

Thank you to "Masa Kei" for providing this feedback!

-

As an additional update, we are currently implementing and testing localization features internally. We will strive to provide localization features in the near future.

-

This post has been translated through AI. If there are any parts that don't sound smooth, please feel free to provide feedback in the comments.
